# Braid Boss Pro

> The business operating system for braid stylists — bookings, deposits, contracts, retail storefronts, marketing, and analytics, built around how braiders actually run their chairs.

Braid Boss Pro is a SaaS platform built specifically for braid stylists (box braids, knotless, locs, twists, cornrows, and natural hair specialists). It is not generic salon software repurposed for braiders — every feature is designed around long, hair-included appointments, deposit policies, contracts, and the creator-economy workflow real braid stylists use.

The platform is delivered as a Progressive Web App (PWA) that installs to a phone's home screen on iOS 16.4+ and Android. There is no app-store download. Stripe Connect handles all payments — Braid Boss Pro never custodies stylist funds.

## Pricing

- 14-day free trial — every feature unlocked
- $14.99 / month after the trial, or $149 / year (save $30.88)
- No contracts, cancel anytime
- Grandfathered lifetime members keep full access at no monthly cost

## Who it's for

- Independent braid stylists running a solo chair
- Studio owners with a small braid-stylist team
- Loctitians, natural hair specialists, and protective-style stylists
- New braid stylists who need a booking link they can share on Instagram

## Core capabilities

- **Branded booking links** — /@yourhandle URL, real-time calendar, automatic conflict checks
- **Stripe Connect deposits + balance payments** — funds land in the stylist's own Stripe account same-day
- **Digital contracts + e-signature** — per-service templates with audit trail
- **Pricing calculator + saved quotes** — quote add-ons, deposits, travel, and tip in seconds
- **Client CRM** — histories, allergies, preferred styles, prep notes, before/after photos
- **Retail storefront** — product variants, inventory, local pickup or Stripe checkout
- **Marketing automation** — SMS + email reminders, rebooking nudges, win-back, birthday greetings
- **SMS messaging** — appointment reminders + transactional messages via Twilio
- **Analytics dashboard** — revenue, retention, busiest days, profit margin per style
- **Reviews + testimonials** — public stylist reviews, private feedback channel
- **Mobile dashboard + PWA install** — works on iPhone Safari and Android Chrome
- **Web push notifications** — instant alerts for new reviews, client cancellations, contract signatures
- **Cloud sync** — work across phone, tablet, and laptop with a single account

## What makes Braid Boss Pro different

- **Built for braiders, not generic salons** — variations, hair-included pricing, long-appointment deposit logic, retail tied to natural hair products
- **Less than every major salon app** — $14.99/mo vs the $24–$48/mo range of Vagaro / StyleSeat / Square Appointments
- **No per-staff fees** — flat pricing
- **Creator-economy first** — handle/booking link feels like Linktree, not a clinic intake form
- **Stylist-owned Stripe account** — Braid Boss Pro never holds funds, runs payouts, or takes a cut
